messages.subject: Unexpected Error 1073741659 cds/mrds
parts:
Hello all,
I have a question regarding data entry and the CDS analysis engine which is=
producing an unexpected error.

My data consist of 10 point transects with a total of ~41k distance observa=
tions spaced out across five days. When I create a project consisting of on=
ly one or two days (~4-12k detections each) have no problem running the CDS=
or MCDS engines with various configurations. However, when all the data ar=
e combined both engines throw the following error regardless of the model d=
efinitions:
***************************************************************************=
********************
** Error: Analysis engine terminated unexpectedly (with error code -1073741=
659). **
-- Start of Analyis Engine Log File --
This is mcds.exe version 6.1.0
Options;
Type=3DPoint;
Distance=3DRadial /Measure=3D'Kilometer';
Area /Units=3D'Hectare';
Object=3DSingle;
SF=3D1;
Selection=3DSpecify;
Confidence=3D95;
Print=3DSelection;
End;
Data /Structure=3DFlat;
Fields=3DSTR_LABEL, STR_AREA, SMP_LABEL, SMP_EFFORT, DISTANCE;
Infile=3DC:\Users\palmer\AppData\Local\Temp\dst222.tmp /NoEcho;
Data will be input from file - [...]\APPDATA\LOCAL\TEMP\DST222.TMP
End;
Dataset has been stored.
Estimate;
Distance;
Density=3DAll;
Encounter=3DAll;
Detection=3DAll;
Size=3DAll;
Estimator /Key=3DHN /Adjust=3DCO /NAP=3D0;
Monotone=3DStrict;
Pick=3DAIC;
GOF;
Cluster /Bias=3DGXLOG;
VarN=3DEmpirical;
End;
***************************************************************************=
****
I have tried importing the days one at a time, in various orders to try to =
find if a specific day of data was causing the problem. However, the error =
seems to come up at random after three of four days have been imported. My =
only thought is that there may be too many observations for the engines to =
handle but according to previous threads and the Distance manual the MCDS e=
ngine can accept up to 100k observations. I have also tried running this an=
alysis in Distance 6.0 as well as 6.1 to no avail. My final and perhaps mos=
t well founded thought was that the error may stem from the following line

Infile=3DC:\Users\palmer\AppData\Local\Temp\dst222.tmp /NoEcho

since the dst222.temp does not exist on my computer.

Thus, any sage wisdom the folks on this list-serve might have to offer woul=
d be greatly appreciated. Thank you in advance.
Cheers,
Kaitlin

messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: Unexpected Error 1073741659 cds/mrds
parts:
Kaitlin:

I believe your suspicion about number of detections is probably
correct. This list has just had a series of queries about the challenge
of achieving 60 detections and you are discussing having 41000 detections.

I see your remark that the users guide says that MCDS can hold 100000
observations, but I don't know of anyone who has fed more than ~10000
observations into Distance. The possible exception might be the BTO
folks analysing 'citizen science' data.

The only advice I can offer is for you to place Distance into 'debug'
mode (look under Preferences | Analysis). By doing so, the temporary
files created by Distance will be retained, and the hints about what may
have gone wrong might be exposed.

If you need to send along your project, let us know off-list and we can
have a look.
